notice: Candidate legal anchors named in the user-supplied framework (docs/reference/FRAMEWORK.md). None has been verified by RSL Legal. Instrument names come from the framework; no section numbers, dates or reviewers are added here except section 113, which the framework names. Every entry must be checked by RSL Legal or a Lesotho tax lawyer before any product use.

entries.topic: Related-party allocation of existing income, deductions and credits
entries.instrument: Income Tax Act 1993, section 113, as limited by the AfriSam judgment
entries.test: Allocation of existing gross income, deductions or credits between associates; not imputation of notional amounts under an arm's-length standard
Was the expense incurred in producing income, and was the service delivered and of benefit to the Lesotho entity
Input tax supported by a valid tax invoice or customs entry; role of the cleared e-invoice during rollout

entries.instrument: VAT Act 2001 imported-services provisions (reverse charge implementation unconfirmed)
entries.test: Whether VAT is due on services supplied by non-residents and how it is accounted for

entries.topic: Withholding tax on payments to non-residents
entries.instrument: Income Tax Act 1993 withholding provisions; applicable treaty rates
entries.test: Withholding on management fees, service fees and interest paid to non-residents, net of treaty relief supported by residence evidence

entries.instrument: Debt-to-equity provision (reported 3:1 limit; scope, including whether it is limited to mining, to confirm)
entries.test: Interest deductions on related-party debt above the permitted ratio

entries.topic: Employment income and PAYE for foreign staff
entries.instrument: Income Tax Act 1993 PAYE provisions; WHT on service fees; dependent-services treaty articles
entries.test: Whether payments described as consultancy fees are employment income of individuals working in Lesotho

entries.instrument: Record-keeping and information-production powers in the Income Tax Act 1993 and VAT Act 2001
entries.test: Power to require the taxpayer's books and source evidence in a standard structure
Refund timelines, interest on late refunds and partial payment of the undisputed amount

entries.instrument: Data Protection Act; RSL confidentiality provisions
entries.test: Lawful use of taxpayer and third-party data; restriction of refund identities to authorised roles
